perf.summary: Build duplicates PrefixFunction.Run verbatim; consolidating removes duplicate code and a second I-cache footprint.
perf.currentCost: Two identical prefix-function implementations (DynamicKmp.Build and PrefixFunction.Run) maintained separately; duplicate instruction-cache pressure and divergence risk.
perf.proposedChange: Have DynamicKmp.Build call PrefixFunction.Run (both AggressiveInlining) instead of reimplementing the loop, or delete Build and document that callers use PrefixFunction.Run.
perf.rationale: Eliminates code duplication; with AggressiveInlining the abstraction is free at runtime and reduces maintenance/divergence risk.
perf.risk: None functionally — the loops are byte-for-byte equivalent (fail vs piPtr naming only).
